title: Non-Clifford symmetry protected topological hyper-cluster states and multi-qubit universal measurement-based quantum computation
summary: A cluster state is a highly entangled quantum state that serves as a universal resource for measurement-based quantum computation. It is generated by applying controlled-Z (CZ) gates to the product state $\left\vert ++\cdots +\right\rangle $, and its parent Hamiltonian is the ZXZ model. This model exhibits a topological phase protected by the $\mathbb{Z}_{2}^{\text{even}}\times \mathbb{Z}_{2}^{\text{odd}}$\ symmetry.
